page.notes: Marginal verse numbers 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35 stand in the right margin (line markers, not notes). Verse 2 and verse 6-8 numbering is as printed; the printed "Verf. 1." is copied as "Vers. 1." only as an approximation of a worn letter, flagged here as doubtful. Greek running head fragment "ϰεῶ͂μο ϖοιέω" at the top of the first line is partly illegible in the scan; the reading "ϰεῶ͂μο" and "ϖοιέω" is uncertain. Several "s" long s forms were read as plain s. The last line "legit" is a catchword and was also placed in the catchword element; the text line "aquas col-" is the printed line break before it. Printed "Esto lux" and "Efto" forms are copied as they look; the word "Viditque" ends a line with a worn letter. Words marked as uncertain: "Verf." read as "Vers.", "Efto" read as "Esto".
